name: Disable Interrupt Moderation
description: Disables interrupt moderation on supported network adapters to prioritize lower input and packet latency for gaming.

description_i18n.en: Disables interrupt moderation on supported network adapters to prioritize lower input and packet latency for gaming.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die Interrupt Moderation auf unterstützten Netzwerkadapters, um geringere Eingabe- und Paketlatenz für Spiele zu priorisieren.
description_i18n.fr: Désactivé la modulation des interruptions sur les cartes réseau prises en charge afin de privilégier une latence d'entrée et de paquet plus faible pour le jeu.

warnings.title: CPU usage impact
warnings.message: Disabling interrupt moderation can increase CPU usage when handling very high throughput connections

warnings.title: Network settings change
warnings.message: Network connectivity may briefly drop or reconnect while the change is applied

compatibility.notes: Only applies to adapters that expose an Interrupt Moderation advanced property.

technical_details: Updates the Interrupt Moderation advanced property on physical network adapters that expose this setting via registry keywords or display names
